in_arabic.name: يَمين
in_arabic.meaning: المعني: اليمين، الجانب اليمين، اليمين يد، المكان اليمني
in_arabic.long_meaning: المعني: اليمين، الاسم يأتي من الجانب اليمني للجسم، والجانب اليمني من الأرض، واليد اليمنية، والمكان اليمني. ويستخدم في القرآن الكريم في العديد من الآيات لوصف اليد اليمنية، والجانب اليمني، والمكان اليمني. ويُعتبر اسم يمني رائعًا يرمز إلى الحظ الجيد، والأمانة، والمسؤولية، ويرافق الأفراد في جميع الأوقات، ويُعتبر اسمًا من أسماء الله تعالى، ويُستخدم أيضًا لوصف الشخصية اليمنية الحسنة.

in_urdu.name: یمین
in_urdu.meaning: معانی: دائیڈا، دائیڈا ہاتھ، جگہ دائیڈا
in_urdu.long_meaning: معانی: دائیڈا، دائیڈا ہاتھ، جگہ دائیڈا۔ یہ نام قرآن میں بھی بڑی اہمیت کا حامل ہے۔ یہ نام ایک طرف سے بھی اہمیت کا حامل ہے۔

in_pashto.name: یمین
in_pashto.meaning: معانی: دائیډی، دائیډی څانګه، دائیډی ځای
in_pashto.long_meaning: معانی: دائیډی، دائیډی څانګه، دائیډی ځای۔ یې نوم اسلامي ژباړونو کې په لویه اړخه کې په ځانګړي ډول په قرآن کريم کې دا نوم په ځانګړي ډول دا نوم داړوګنه کوي.

in_english.name: Yamin
in_english.meaning: Right hand, right side, right place, Yemin region, right
in_english.long_meaning: Right hand, right side, right place. It is a name that comes from the Arabic root meaning "right" or "correct". In the Quran, Yamin is used to describe the right hand, the right side, and the right place. It is a name that symbolizes good fortune, honesty, and responsibility, and is often associated with people who are trustworthy and dependable.

data.cultural_impact: The name Yamin holds a significant cultural impact in the Arab world and among Arabic communities worldwide. In Arab culture, being right-handed is considered a strength and an advantage. It is believed that right-handed individuals possess a better sense of coordination, strength, and dexterity. Yamin, as a name, carries this cultural recognition and thus, is often given to children as a sign of hope for their future success and triumph.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Islamic faith, Yamin takes on deeper spiritual meaning, symbolizing blessings and divine guidance. It is believed that Allah (God) favors the righteous and supports them in their journey through life. Hence, the name Yamin represents the unwavering belief in Allah's unwavering support and guidance. The name Yamin is often given to children as a reminder of the importance of striving towards righteousness and living in obedience to Allah's will. By bearing this name, one aspires to lead a life steeped in goodness, righteousness, and spiritual growth.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Yamin ibn Muawiya was the name of the eldest son of Caliph Muawiya I. The name Yamin carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Muawiya I was the fifth Rightly Guided Caliph of Islam and ruled from 661 to 680 AD. Yamin was his eldest son and heir apparent.
